product_family: Discord is a real-time communication platform (voice, video, text chat) with integrated AI features including AutoMod AI for content moderation, conversation summaries, and search functionality. Previously offered Clyde (OpenAI-powered chatbot) which was discontinued in 2026.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Although Discord takes security seriously with encryption and robust security practices, it has not undergone a formal SOC 2 audit to achieve certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Discord does not have ISO 27001 certification, whereas competitors like Slack do.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Discord and its U.S. entities/subsidiaries also comply with the EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Frameworks, as well as the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: Data Privacy Framework Certification (EU-U.S., UK, Swiss)
certifications.proof_quote: Discord and its U.S. entities/subsidiaries also comply with the EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Frameworks, as well as the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification. Discord is a consumer/gaming-focused platform without enterprise healthcare compliance claims.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on vendor-domain resources.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification on vendor-domain resources.

privacy.ai_training_note: Discord does not allow external AI companies (e.g., OpenAI) to train their models using Discord user data. OpenAI cannot use Discord data to train general models. Discord's own AI features (AutoMod AI, summaries) may analyze user data, but users can opt out via Privacy & Safety > How we use your data toggle. Previous concerns arose in 2025 when Discord revised its privacy policy following backlash over AI training practices; the company clarified that Clyde would not use user data for training external models.
privacy.data_region: Not specified; Discord has EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certification indicating EU/US data flows

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS (Transport Layer Security) used for all text and image communications

security.name: Voice and Video Encryption
security.value: End-to-end encrypted; users can verify encryption status in service

security.name: Text Message Encryption
security.value: Encrypted in transit via TLS, but not end-to-end encrypted. Discord stores data in readable format on servers for moderation purposes.

security.name: Trust & Safety Team
security.value: Dedicated team for content moderation, CSAM detection, policy enforcement, and law enforcement cooperation

security.name: Transparency Reporting
security.value: Quarterly transparency reports published covering policy enforcement, legal requests, IP removal requests, and moderation actions

security.name: AI for Content Moderation
security.value: AutoMod AI detects rule violations and CSAM; Conversation Summaries use ML to identify key topics and decisions; tools for community moderation without constant human oversight

products.name: Discord (Core Platform)
products.data_scope: Voice, video, text, files, user profiles, server metadata
products.notes: Free and paid tiers (Nitro). Includes voice channels, video calls, text chat, rich media sharing, user presence, moderation tools.

products.name: AutoMod AI
products.notes: AI-powered content filtering for rule violations; detects CSAM; customizable per server. May train on user data but users can opt out of data collection for AI features.

products.name: Conversation Summaries
products.data_scope: Message content within channels where feature is enabled
products.notes: Uses ML to identify key topics, questions, decisions. Feature opt-in/out at user and server level.

products.name: Clyde (DISCONTINUED)
products.data_scope: Messages in threads where Clyde was invoked
products.notes: Powered by OpenAI; supported by Midjourney image generation. Shut down in 2026 after ~1 year of testing. OpenAI was contractually prohibited from using Discord user data for training external models. Discontinued due to privacy concerns and low user adoption.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (core platform) + subscription (Nitro). No explicit per-seat pricing for AI features.
compare.data_residency: Not explicitly specified; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certification indicates compliant international transfers

flags: Nudge Security's profile claims Discord holds SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRamp, and CSA STAR Level 1 certifications, but multiple sources, including OCD-Tech and independent security analysts, contradict these claims, and no vendor-domain evidence supports them.
Discord is a single product with integrated AI features; there is no separate 'Discord AI' product.
Unlike enterprise competitors (Slack, Microsoft Teams), Discord lacks formal SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, limiting suitability for regulated or enterprise use cases.
Discord has experienced data breaches (e.g. government ID exposure from its age verification system), relevant to enterprise trust assessment.
The Clyde chatbot was shut down after about a year due to low adoption and privacy concerns.

The privacy policy was revised in February 2025 following user backlash over AI training implications. Users can opt out of data collection for AI, though the effect on feature quality or availability is unclear.

Text messages are not end-to-end encrypted (only TLS in transit), meaning Discord employees and automated systems can access readable content for moderation. This is a material difference from end-to-end encrypted platforms.
Discord claims GDPR compliance via the Data Privacy Framework but does not hold a formal ISO 27001 certification or third-party audit. The DPF is a legal framework, not a security certification.
